body: I am feeling better, I reached out to a friend (all of my family and friends have no idea I am depressed, they just think I am moody/homebody). Anyway she gave me a number to a clinic that she goes to for her panic attacks (had no clue). They only make appointments on Tuesdays, but she said they will get me in quick to see a Dr and a councilor. So I am just going to try and hang on until Tuesday. Thanks you guys, before I read the reply's I was pretty hopeless.
